title: Shopping assistant
storageNotice: This chat is kept in this browser tab, and we store it for 90 days to improve our help. Please don't share card numbers or passwords.
greeting: Hi! I can help you find products, check your cart, track orders and start returns.
placeholder: Ask about products, orders or returns…
photoNotice: Photos are only used to answer you and aren't stored.
errPhotoRead: That photo couldn't be read. Please try another one.
errPhotoTooBig: That photo is too large. Please send a smaller one.
errPhotoOff: Photos aren't available right now. You can still type your question.
errPhotoLimit: You've sent as many photos as you can for today. You can still type your question.
voiceDone: Stopped listening. Check the text, then send.
voiceHint: Your browser turns speech into text. We never get the audio.
errMicDenied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or type your question.
errMicNoSpeech: I didn't hear anything. Try again, or type your question.
errMicUnavailable: Voice input isn't working right now. You can still type your question.
errNetwork: Can't reach the assistant right now.
errTooLong: Messages can be up to {max} characters.
errRateLimited: You're sending messages quickly. Please wait a moment.
errDailyLimit: You've reached today's limit for the assistant. Please try again tomorrow, or contact us.
errConversationLimit: This chat has reached its limit. Please try again tomorrow, or contact us.
errGuestsPaused: The assistant is busy right now. Please sign in to keep chatting.
errTooManyChats: You've started a lot of chats in the last hour. Please continue in this one, or try again later.
fallbackTitle: The assistant isn't available right now
fallbackText: You can keep shopping as usual. Please try the chat again later.
fallbackHelp: You can keep shopping as usual. For orders, returns and questions, our help page has everything you need.
help: Track an order or contact us
checkoutNote: You'll review your order and pay on the checkout page.
memoryNote: I remember what you asked me to keep from earlier chats.
ticketCreated: Message sent to our support team
